msContents.summary: Invocation to Osiris as nocturnal manifestation of the sun-god in the context of a ritual for the king.

support.note: The fibers of the recto are not straight (Quack, Anrufungen an Osiris (2012), 165). The sheet join on Frg. 3 was made carefully.

list.item: object's condition: incomplete - three fragments without direct joins - the upper margin of Frg. 3 is nearly complete - Frg. 2 consists of two fragments that belong next to each other
